name: Dreamhunter: The Prophecy
source:
Dreamhunter: The Prophecy is a fantasy visual novel with elements of horror, romance and detective mystery.
You are a seer.  Hang out with your eccentric friends.  Decode ominous prophetic dreams.  Debate (and then date) an eldritch horror.  And, most importantly, ⠋⠊⠝⠙ ⠁ ⠺⠁⠽ ⠞⠕ ⠺⠁⠅⠑ ⠥⠏.
